subject: Air freight quote to LOS
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the cheapest air freight option to LOS (Lagos, NG) for automotive sensors? Pickup is at our site in 36627 (Fulda), Germany, ready on 2026-11-29. Please arrange the truck to the airport and quote one all-in price in EUR.

Lot 1: 4 drums, together 730 kg gross (642 kg net), together 1.68 cbm
Lot 2: 4 cartons, each 48 kg gross (41 kg net), each 110 x 110 x 52 cm
Lot 3: 5 cases, each 206 kg gross (191 kg net), each 120 x 100 x 8 cm

Please book all lots as a single consignment under one air waybill.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
